question: Sitara Devi was a classical dancer of India who used to perform __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sitara Devi** was an acclaimed Indian classical dancer known for her mastery in **Kathak**, a dance form originating from North India.
 
• She was often referred to as the "**Empress of Kathak**" due to her outstanding contributions to the art form.
 
• Sitara Devi introduced Kathak to global audiences and performed at prestigious venues, including the **Royal Albert Hall in London** and **Carnegie Hall in New York**.
 
• She received numerous accolades during her lifetime, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the **Padma Shri**, for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• Sitara Devi was instrumental in adapting Kathak for stage performances, blending traditional elements with innovative choreography.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• The term "**Kathak**" is derived from the Sanskrit word "**Katha**," meaning story, as the dance form traditionally narrates mythological tales.
 
• Kathak has three major gharanas (schools) - **Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras**, each emphasizing different aspects of the dance form.
 
• The dance form is heavily influenced by both **Hindu and Mughal traditions**, incorporating elements of Bhakti and Persian aesthetics.
 
• Classical Kathak performances are often accompanied by live music, including instruments like **tabla**, **sitar**, and **harmonium**.
